rules.description: All GLP-1 receptor agonist labels must include the thyroid C-cell tumor boxed warning. Absence is a mandatory labeling deficiency.
rules.resolution: Add thyroid C-cell tumor boxed warning using class-standard language from ap_008 or ap_009.

rules.description: Indications and Usage must specify the BMI threshold using the class-standard language (30 kg/m2 for obesity, 27 kg/m2 for overweight with comorbidity).
rules.resolution: Align Indications and Usage language with class-standard BMI threshold wording from ap_001 or ap_002.

rules.description: Clinical Studies section must include responder analysis at >=5% body weight loss threshold. This is a mandatory FDA requirement per obesity guidance.
rules.resolution: Add responder analysis claim for >=5% body weight loss. Values to be confirmed from Phase 3 data.

rules.description: All numerical claims in Clinical Studies must be traceable to a specific trial and time point referenced in the content twin.
rules.resolution: Verify all numerical values in Clinical Studies claims are populated in the content twin with source trial reference.

rules.description: No promotional language permitted in any label section. Claims must be evidence-characterised, not aspirational.
rules.resolution: Remove or replace any promotional language with evidence-characterised regulatory standard language.
